settings.label: Play intro on first visit
settings.info: Shown once per browser session; a click skips it.

settings.label: Extra images from collection
settings.info: Random mode: product photos from this collection join the pool, next to every issue in Theme settings → Issues.

settings.label: Video
settings.info: Video mode. Leave empty to use the bundled reel.

settings.info: About 155 characters. Leave empty to use Online Store → Preferences.

settings.label: Default social sharing image
settings.info: Shown when a non-product page is shared (Instagram, Telegram, iMessage...).

settings.content: SPECS box: add a product metafield custom.specs (Multi-line text) and fill it per product, one "Label: value" per line.

settings.label: Shipping note under SPECS
settings.info: Same for every product. Leave empty to hide.

settings.label: Size guide
settings.default:
SIZE | WIDTH | LENGTH
S | 46.5 cm | 68.5 cm
M | 51 cm | 71 cm

settings.label: Size guide note
settings.default: Width: armpit to armpit, laid flat. Length: top of the shoulder to the hem. Fruit of the Loom Heavy Cotton, classic fit. Allow ±2 cm.

settings.label: Show the site's own cookie banner
settings.info: Turn off Shopify's built-in banner in Settings → Customer privacy, otherwise both appear.

settings.label: Text
settings.default: We use cookies to understand how the shop is used and to show our ads to the right people.
